speaker: Adam
text: Good morning, Moiz! Did you catch the first half of the Spain vs Argentina World Cup final? A goalless draw, but it sounds like there were plenty of talking points!

speaker: Adam
text: Speaking of atmospheres, let’s dive into some world news. First up, we have twin earthquakes striking Peru, causing significant damage and claiming at least five lives. The quakes, measuring 5.1 and 3.7, hit the mountainous region east of Lima.

speaker: Eve
text: That’s devastating news. Peru has experienced its fair share of seismic activity, but it’s always tragic when lives are lost.

speaker: Adam
text: Absolutely. On a different note, Andy Burnham is set to become the new UK Prime Minister on Monday, and he’s already facing a mountain of challenges. With the UK getting its seventh PM in just ten years, political stability seems like a distant dream.

speaker: Eve
text: Yeah, it’ll be interesting to see how he handles foreign policy, especially with ongoing conflicts in Ukraine and Iran.

speaker: Adam
text: And just when you think things can’t get more chaotic, news comes out of New York. Fans have lit up NYC’s Little Argentina in celebration ahead of the World Cup final, but security is tight, especially after former President Trump’s visit caused logistical delays at the stadium.

speaker: Eve
text: Oh, that sounds like a mix of excitement and frustration! The buzz of the World Cup can really bring people together, but those queues must have tested everyone’s patience.

speaker: Adam
text: And in other news, Lebanese food influencer Georges Hanna Dib, better known as Dr. Food, has been sentenced to life for drug smuggling. He was caught attempting to smuggle hashish out of Lebanon hidden in cake packaging.

speaker: Eve
text: That’s such a bizarre story! Who would have thought a food influencer would get involved in something like that?

speaker: Adam
text: Right? It’s a shocking fall from grace. Meanwhile, in Iran, the supreme leader has called for calm amid rising political divides after hardliners accused officials of treason for signing an agreement with the US.

speaker: Eve
text: Tensions are high there, and it’s a critical time for leadership and unity.

speaker: Adam
text: Switching gears to some alarming news from Mali, at least 50 soldiers were killed in an attack on a military convoy. This ongoing conflict shows no signs of letting up.

text: That’s heart-wrenching. It’s hard to comprehend the loss of life in these situations.

speaker: Adam
text: Lastly, in a miraculous turn, five passengers, including a seven-year-old girl, were rescued after drifting for days following a boat sinking in Indonesia.

speaker: Eve
text: Wow, that’s a relief amidst all the chaos! It’s amazing how survival stories can emerge from such tragic events.
